groups.name: The Gentlemen
groups.profile: First seen: reporting is inconsistent (MITRE/Blackpoint: mid-to-late 2025; SOCRadar: 2023). RaaS double-extortion operation; initial access via exposed VPN/firewall appliances (incl. CVE-2024-55591 in FortiOS/FortiProxy) and stolen credentials, then extended recon, BYOVD evasion and fast ransomware deployment.
groups.countries: Australia, Brazil, Canada, Czech Republic, Ecuador, Ireland, Kazakhstan, Pakistan, South Africa, South Korea, Taiwan, United Kingdom, United States
groups.sectors: Agriculture and Food Production, Education, Energy & Utilities, Financial Services, Government & Defense, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Other, Professional Services, Technology, Transportation

groups.name: 7 Deadly Sins
groups.profile: Emerging data-broker/extortion operation per WatchGuard; mixes direct extortion, double extortion and free data leaks; prior victims concentrated in healthcare, IT, electronics and professional services (mostly US, with Canada/Australia/Brazil cases) — consistent with today's spread.

groups.name: N0n
groups.profile: Active since at least September 2026 per our tracking. Posts a mix of named victims and a high volume of anonymized "Company #NN" placeholder listings (12 more excluded from this issue as masked). Independent researchers (Fortra) note some of its marquee claims remain unconfirmed.

groups.name: INC Ransom
groups.profile: Established double-extortion operation active since mid-2023; has repeatedly hit healthcare and public-sector targets; initial access generally via phishing or exploitation of internet-facing applications. RansomLook-only in today's feeds.

groups.name: Play
groups.profile: Established double-extortion RaaS active since 2022, publicly documented by CISA (AA23-352A); exploits FortiOS/Fortinet and Microsoft Exchange (ProxyNotShell) vulnerabilities plus compromised RDP for initial access.

groups.name: Pear
groups.profile: Newer/low-volume leak-site operation; limited independent public profiling available. RansomLook-only in today's feeds.

groups.name: Redact
groups.profile: Newer entrant; limited independent public profiling available. No TTP attribution asserted.

groups.profile: Newer/low-volume leak-site operation; limited independent public profiling available.

groups.name: Deadlock

groups.name: Everest
groups.profile: Data-extortion operation active since ~2020–2021 with alleged Russian-speaking ties; mixes ransomware deployment with pure data-extortion listings; has previously targeted healthcare and government victims. RansomLook-only in today's feeds.

groups.name: LockBit5
groups.profile: Latest branded iteration of the long-running LockBit RaaS lineage (active since 2019) following 2024 law-enforcement disruption of LockBit 3.0 infrastructure; affiliates typically use phishing or exploitation of internet-facing applications. RansomLook-only in today's feeds.

groups.name: Qilin
groups.profile: Established double-extortion RaaS active since 2022; initial access typically via compromised VPN/RDP credentials or exploitation of internet-facing VPN appliances.
